title: One-row compensated FP8 screen exposes a rank-one to rank-two contraction gap in Cake

evidence.public_assessment_object: result.json and three complete schedule-*.json variants

observation: The two-row Cake SIMT route and both standalone one-row/two-row variants passed the same five frozen 64x64 E4M3FN-to-FP32 cases with unchanged FP8 input bytes. A same-process C550-2 Triton 3.6 MCPTI diagnostic under the local maca broker used the declared 4x-L2 same-stream reset, 10 reversed pairs of 25 samples per arm, 11 warmups per cohort, and four A/A control pairs. Repository dispatch_samples and derive_paired_timing replay accepted all 29 activity cohorts: the one-row baseline pooled median was 31.232 us, the two-row candidate 42.496 us, with the one-row arm winning 10/10 pairs; the A/A medians were both 31.488 us and all cohort CV gates passed. The Cake two-row source had a separate, nonpaired 39.168 us median cohort. This is a directional diagnostic under local_serialized with external GPU activity not excluded, not a registered Workload receipt, formal performance qualification or proof that Cake can emit the faster one-row source. Public Compiler.assess then located the current structural gap: a one-row program axis with program_tile access is refused by ACCESS_PROGRAM_AXIS_UNTILED; changing the access to a scalar program coordinate while retaining [1,64] register tiles is refused by LOAD_ACCESS_SHAPE_MISMATCH and STORE_ACCESS_SHAPE_MISMATCH; making those values rank-one leaves MMA_INPUT_TILE_DOMAIN as the blocking verifier rule. The admitted two-row case retains only nonblocking RESIDENCY_BOUND.
proposed_change: First assess whether an existing canonical operation can explicitly promote one scalar-program row to a rank-two [1,64] operand without misusing index_expand or hiding an access effect. If not, design the smallest rank-one by rank-two contraction or explicit singleton-axis primitive with its typing, access/dataflow, lifetime/resource analyses, target-specific preflight and lowering in one change. Preserve the currently admitted two-row route, reject unsupported shapes by the rule that owns them, and keep NVIDIA/AMD/Metal behavior unchanged. Require a new one-row Cake source, exact 3.1/3.6 compilation, full five-case device correctness, a registered fixed Workload, and qualified paired confirmation before promoting a performance claim. Do not relax the general MMA tile rule solely to make this one probe lower.
principles: P1/P3 require one clear authoring and canonical singleton-axis form; P2 names SIMT compensation and exposes the one-row mapping; P4/P5/P7 require typing and every affected analysis with the primitive; P6 requires positive and owned-refusal Corpus cases; P8 does not infer a native FP8 matrix instruction or broad C550 performance from this diagnostic.

successor_evidence.observation: The existing cast, broadcast, multiply and reduce primitives express a one-row Cake source with no new IR or instruction contract. At 936fd3b6 it compiled on the captured C550-1 Triton 3.1 and C550-2 Triton 3.6 routes; C550-2 job maca-7d524849272b passed the original five fixed cases within the unchanged atol=0.001, rtol=0.0001, but primary and mixed_magnitude had 2166 and 1263 FP32 word differences from the gold. A separate 10-pair MCPTI diagnostic independently replayed 28 accepted activity cohorts, with Cake plain sum 5.120 us versus the one-row compensated baseline 31.232 us pooled medians and 10/10 pair wins; A/A was close_null and quality passed. The diagnostic lacks a sealed Workload receipt and does not qualify a general speedup. A deterministic CPU held-out screen of 100 additional finite-E4M3FN 64x64 cases found 14 tolerance failures among 409600 outputs. The first failed point was rechecked with math.fsum: observed -49.8515625 versus reference -49.85791015625, absolute error 0.00634765625 against allowance 0.005985791015625. Thus the fast plain-sum composition is a fixed-case candidate, not a precision-preserving replacement for the compensated route.

promotion_disposition: No promotion of the plain-sum candidate as general MetaX FP8 lowering. Keep the fixed two-row compensated route and its exact Target guard. The one-row compensated capacity gap remains proposed; its necessity must be judged against a registered Workload and held-out precision requirements. Route a new singleton-axis mechanism through IR, typing, access/dataflow and analysis review rather than hiding a reshape or widening the Target from the five-case timing screen.
